snippet.title: Oscuro Blossom's Glow | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Oscuro Blossom's Glow is an atmospheric 2D platformer where you guide Oscuro, a creature of darkness, through a mystical world. Oscuro discovers a radiant blossom whose light is essential for navigating the shadowy environments. Solve light-based puzzles, overcome challenging platforming sections, and uncover the connection between Oscuro and the glowing flower.
